title: Ocean Fresh British Corn Trifle
description: A light and festive British dish featuring sake-cooked corn and fry-grind-rice-khao-khua, perfect for special occasions. This egg-free-friendly trifle is a unique and delicious twist on traditional British cuisine.
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine sake and corn kernels, and cook over medium heat until the corn is tender.
In a blender or food processor, grind the fry-grind-rice-khao-khua into a fine powder.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sugar, heavy cream, vanilla extract, lemon zest, and salt.
Add the cooked corn and powdered fry-grind-rice-khao-khua to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a large serving dish or individual glasses.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, garnish with additional lemon zest and a sprinkle of sugar.
